note: Everything the research could not close, stated as open rather than answered. A document appears here if its final status requires a human decision or an issuer response, or if its current revision or last-confirmed date could not be established from an official source.

openQuestions.question: Will the Kansas Judicial Council grant express permission for commercial generation and redistribution of its expungement forms, and on what terms?
openQuestions.why: All ten Kansas documents carry a published non-commercial-use restriction. Kansas is the one jurisdiction acquisition cannot unblock at any price.

openQuestions.question: Where did the revision '10/14/2025' in KS-CRIMINAL-COVER-SHEET-10-14-2025 come from?
openQuestions.why: Three independent Kansas Judicial Council document pages label the file 12-2014, and no official Kansas source publishes a 2025 criminal cover sheet. The queue's sourceIdentityConfidence of document_identity_and_issuer_confirmed is not supportable.

openQuestions.question: Which entity is the correct grantor for a commercial-use and derivative-works licence over the Coalition for Court Access expungement forms — Indiana Legal Help Inc., the Coalition, the Indiana Bar Foundation, or the Office of Judicial Administration?
openQuestions.why: The forms are approved by a Supreme Court-created body and promoted by the judiciary's own self-service page, but published on a site whose Terms of Service bar commercial use and derivative works. The four entities are not the same.

openQuestions.question: What are the current approved versions of CR143, CR310, CR311 and CR370, and were they reissued alongside the SJRC (10-24) reissues of CR300, CR301 and CR360?
openQuestions.why: OSCA publishes petition forms publicly but publishes no judgment or order form on any public index; circuits obtain and re-host them locally. These four cannot be closed by any download.
openQuestions.owner: operations to send, counsel to approve the text

openQuestions.question: Confirm the FI-05 to FI-50 substitution across all eight Missouri components and re-derive the 111-field mapping against FI-50's five-page layout.
openQuestions.why: FI-05 was removed from the official index and replaced by FI-50 (SJRC 07-25). The Edition 1.2 addendum's case-code analysis also rests on a superseded Case Types List.

openQuestions.question: What is the official title, form number, revision and fee schedule of the Delaware SBI mandatory-expungement application, and may a blank specimen be reproduced?
openQuestions.why: The SBI issues it by mail to an identified applicant after a fingerprint-based criminal-history review. It is not published, not indexed and not downloadable — the only document in the entire set that cannot be closed by any download.

openQuestions.question: Does ca-diversion-seal stage 2 become a county-scoped track, or stay failed closed?
openQuestions.why: There is no statewide Judicial Council form for the PC § 851.90 route; SDSC CRM-307 is a San Diego local optional form. Manifesting it as a statewide primary filing would generate wrong-court filings outside San Diego.

openQuestions.question: Is TC0021 actually XFA?
openQuestions.why: The repository contradicts itself inside a single record: the measured audit says clean_acroform with 29 fields and xfa false, while the free-text note on the same record and the Edition 1.2 manifest assert XFA. The genuine XFA document in the Massachusetts set is the Probation Service Petition to Expunge, served from an Adobe LiveCycle template.

openQuestions.question: Is typesetting mandatory statutory form text an official form or a custom pleading?
openQuestions.why: La. C.Cr.P. art. 986 makes the statutory text itself the mandatory form. There is no issuing forms office, no revision number and no official statewide fillable binary. The Louisiana Supreme Court city and parish packet is expressly non-mandatory and must not be treated as statewide.

openQuestions.question: Does Fla. R. Crim. P. 3.989 contain a continuation form?
openQuestions.why: The rule's own title names three forms — affidavit, petition and order. If it carries no continuation page, the component is describing an attachment convention rather than a rule form and should be re-scoped rather than acquired.

openQuestions.question: Should the pipeline ingest DOCX?
openQuestions.why: The Arizona AOC's current published artefact for the Rule 41 and second-chance families is a Word document, not an AcroForm PDF. Edition 1.2 holds PDFs for three of them whose provenance is therefore unestablished and cannot be closed by revision match alone.

openQuestions.question: Is 'no restriction identified' sufficient to redistribute commercially?
openQuestions.why: In Arkansas, Illinois, Delaware, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Arizona and Missouri no issuer publishes reproduction or commercial-use terms — but none publishes an affirmative grant either. Absence of a prohibition is not a licence.
